name: Reine–Å
format: Uint16 little-endian, decimetres, sea = 0, row 0 = north, column 0 = west; pixel (c,r) centre = (grid_west_m+(c+0.5)*pixel_m, grid_north_m-(r+0.5)*pixel_m)
ele_note: DEM (reine_aa.bin) sampled bilinearly on the OSM road line, bridge/tunnel spans (+-30 m) linearly interpolated between portals, smoothed (2x moving average +-100 m)
description: E10 Lofotveien von Flakstad (Flakstadøya) nach Westen: Ramberg, Krystad, Kåkernbrua, Fjøsdalstunnelen nach Moskenesøya, Skredoverbauten Berget/Ølkonna/Akkarvika, Hamnøytunnelen, Brücken Breisundet/Olenilsøy/Storvalen über Hamnøy und Sakrisøy, an Reine vorbei, Ramsvik- und Seljelitunnel, Moskenes (Fähre), Sørvågen, Tind bis zur Wendeschleife am Ende der E10 in Å i Lofoten.
sea_side_note: -1 = sea on the left, 1 = sea on the right, 0 = no sea within 800 m (or both sides, e.g. on bridges; always 0 inside tunnels); relative to riding direction
tunnel_note: tunnel_kinds from OSM tag tunnel=*: 'yes' = rock tunnel, 'avalanche_protector' = covered avalanche gallery (skredoverbygg, open side towards the sea possible)
